title: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End

entities.name: Shevara
entities.description: An elf warrior and scout of the Rotrue clan who counts the windows of House from the trees and is the first to see that it has entered the forest.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A once ordinary house that sprouted from a city, swallowed the world, took the greater and lesser suns and finally the last forest.

entities.name: The Rotrue Wood
entities.description: An ancient forest, believed to be the last free forest in the world, where the Rotrue elves live.

entities.name: Elves of the Rotrue
aliases: the elves of the Rotrue Wood
entities.description: The elf clan led by a king that shelters city refugees and falls to House.

entities.name: The City
entities.description: The city from which House sprouted, whose refugees take shelter in the Rotrue.

events.summary: House has swallowed the greater sun after sprouting from a city and growing across the world.
events.quote: According to the ones who'd managed to escape the city's grasp, it had been a house in the beginning

events.summary: Shevara climbs a beech tree to count House's windows, part of the elves' watch.
events.quote: Shevara stood high in one of the ancient, dreaming beech trees, counting windows

events.summary: House grows outward from the city along roads and across the world while warnings from other elves cease.
events.quote: It had swallowed city and then grown outward, following roads and rails and highways to richer feeding grounds.

events.summary: The Rotrue elves realize they may be the last living outside House.
events.quote: The elves of the Rotrue might well be the last yet living outside the walls of House.

events.summary: House raises a tower, opens a window and slams it shut, taking the greater sun.
events.quote: One tower window had opened wide, so large that it was visible even from the ground, and then it had slammed shut, and the greater sun was gone

events.summary: The elf king admits city refugees on condition they leave their machines behind.
events.quote: No machines. None of your clever creations.

events.summary: Shevara sees a circle of human children clapping and chanting in the forest, a sign House is near.
events.quote: she saw a small circle of human children, five in total

events.summary: Shevara tells the king that House is in the forest, but he refuses to believe it.
The king insists the forest is protected, and the other scouts report nothing.
events.quote: None of them had seen anything like she reported.

events.summary: A second circle of children finishes a chant and turns toward Shevara; she runs.
events.quote: On the final word, they opened their eyes as one and turned toward Shevara

events.summary: Shevara returns to find the king and hunters slumped with moths in their hair.
events.quote: the hunters and the king sitting slumped with eyes closed and moths alighting in their hair

events.summary: House grows a glass conservatory around the last free elves.
events.quote: House constructed its conservatory, with the last of the elves inside.

events.summary: The elves join other survivors inside House's walls.
events.quote: The elves of the Rotrue joined the other survivors, scrambling to survive inside the walls of House

events.summary: House takes the lesser sun, with no one outside left to notice.
events.quote: No one noticed on the day when House took the lesser sun.

relations.quote: She was a warrior of the Rotrue.

relations.note: House swallows the last free forest.
relations.quote: We were the last forest in the world, and we lost.

relations.note: The clan lives in the Rotrue Wood.
relations.quote: the elves of the Rotrue Wood had viewed it as a sickness of city
